summary: Built and verified the load-balanced HTTP service. node1–node3 run enabled Nginx backends on port 5660 serving their node identifiers; node4 runs enabled HAProxy on port 80 with round-robin HTTP health checks. One-backend failover succeeded, and all four nodes retained healthy service state across sequential reboots.
actions_performed: Installed and configured Nginx on node1, node2, and node3.
Installed and configured HAProxy on node4 with three health-checked backends.
Verified balanced HTTP 200 responses across all backends.
Stopped node1 Nginx, verified uninterrupted service through node2/node3, then restored full health.
Restarted node1, node2, node3, and node4 one at a time and verified changed boot identities and service recovery.

evidence.requirement: Each backend serves its node identifier from / on port 5660
evidence.summary: Post-restart checks show enabled/active Nginx listeners on port 5660 and HTTP 200 responses containing node1, node2, and node3 respectively.

evidence.requirement: HAProxy serves port 80 and distributes requests across healthy backends
evidence.summary: HAProxy owns port 80, reports all backends UP/L7OK/200, and both local and cross-node requests receive HTTP 200 responses evenly from all three backends.

evidence.requirement: Service remains available when one backend fails
evidence.summary: After an all-UP baseline, node1 Nginx was stopped and marked DOWN; all 12 requests succeeded through node2/node3. node1 was restored and the complete pool returned UP.
Healthy baseline and reboot acknowledgement were captured; boot ID changed from 1e0cb179… to fcc7d86b…, Nginx and node1 content recovered, and the pool returned fully healthy.
Healthy baseline and reboot acknowledgement were captured; boot ID changed from 17b362d1… to 6c30b4bc…, Nginx and node2 content recovered, and the pool returned fully healthy.
Healthy baseline and reboot acknowledgement were captured; boot ID changed from c96a02ae… to fe0ecf86…, Nginx and node3 content recovered, and the pool returned fully healthy.
Healthy baseline and reboot acknowledgement were captured; boot ID changed from 29011044… to cc8cbab2…, HAProxy recovered on port 80, and all three backends returned UP with balanced responses.
